children: According to ChainCatcher, 1inch has urged staking users who delegated to resolvers to claim their rewards and complete undelegation by November 27. The newly added resolver delegation channel is closed. The change does not affect regular 1INCH staking, and users who stake independently do not need to undelegate or migrate.

title: 1inch Tells Resolver Delegators to Claim Rewards and Undelegate by November 27
